summary: Iteration 3 full e2e verification for YourMovie's — quality tiers, custom VideoPlayer + Google IMA, auto-rotating hero, full-page admin form, admin users tab, subscription page, multi-profiles. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (subscription current returns all fields, cancel/resume returns 400 without stripe_subscription_id, admin-only list/toggle/delete users with self-delete guard, profiles CRUD with 403 for non-premium + 4 max limit, media qualities and featured_order persistence). Frontend (Playwright): 10/10 flows pass — Home auto-rotating hero shows BBB and 'Regarder' navigates to /watch; Anon Watch page shows quality-720p only, 1080p/4k rendered as locked links to /pricing; Premium admin Watch shows all 3 quality-720p/1080p/4k testids clickable; Google IMA SDK script is injected (ad playback falls back gracefully); Admin has both admin-tab-media and admin-tab-users tabs, users list shows toggle-admin-{id} & delete-user-{id} buttons; /admin/media/new is a full-page form (0 modals) with add-quality-btn + form-featured + form-featured-order; /admin/media/{id}/edit loads BBB data + its 3 quality rows; /account/subscription shows sub-plan='premium' + cancel-btn for premium admin; /profiles allows premium admin to open modal, fill name, save, and profile appears in grid; MediaCard href points to /media/{id} only (no /watch) and has no play-circle overlay.

issues: GENRE and ANNÉE dropdowns use native <select> instead of shadcn Select component — inconsistent with rest of the app which uses shadcn Select (see /admin/media/new form-type). Minor UX polish.
DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (React a11y warning in console). Minor a11y issue.

action_items: (Optional) Replace native <select> in BrowsePage filters with shadcn Select for consistency.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to profile creation dialog to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 950 lines and mixes 8 domains (auth, media, reviews, favorites, uploads, Stripe, watch-progress, similar, subscription mgmt, profiles, admin users). Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, media.py, payments.py, watch.py, admin.py, profiles.py) — exceeds the >700-line threshold from code review guidelines.

VideoPlayer.jsx (438 lines) — quality change reloads <video> src which will restart ad pod on some browsers if IMA plays post-ad; consider using HTMLMediaElement.setSinkId or Adaptive Bitrate via HLS/DASH manifest for smoother switching. Also the useEffect that starts main video after adsFinished can race if the user paused during ad (playing state stale).

Backend cancel/resume return 400 when stripe_subscription_id is null — good, but the SubscriptionPage never calls /subscription/cancel for such a user because it renders the plan card even when sub_id is null (manual premium via admin flag). Clicking cancel-btn would show a red toast with 'No active subscription'. Consider hiding cancel-btn when !sub?.stripe_subscription_id to avoid dead-end UX.

AdminMediaForm.jsx — uploadFile for kind='video' via `default_video` cb sets video_file_path but doesn't build a URL; a downstream player then can't play it unless it also has video_url. Consider auto-populating video_url = buildFileUrl(p).
ProfilesPage — save reloads list but does not clear the persisted ym_profile_id if it references a now-deleted profile.

HomePage — featured_order default 999 in JS sort but backend allows null; fine. Featured-only query works but the fallback to `all.data.slice(0,1)` when no featured items may show a random newest item as hero (acceptable).

Admin toggle-admin has no guard against demoting the last remaining admin (a self-lockout scenario if only one admin toggles themselves). Non-critical since backend already blocks self-delete, but consider similar guard for last-admin demotion.

Regular test user user@yourmovies.app registered via /api/auth/register (safe to keep). All TEST_-prefixed profiles created during tests were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 is fully green. BBB media in DB currently has 3 identical qualities (all pointing to the same Google BBB MP4) — if you need genuinely different quality streams, update via PUT /api/media/{id}. Admin is manually premium (no stripe_subscription_id) so real Stripe subscription flow (cancel/resume 200 path) can only be tested end-to-end via Stripe test-mode checkout completion. The IMA SDK script IS loaded but Google's sample VAST tag often fails in headless/preview browsers — this is expected and the player falls back to direct video play. Native <select> on /browse for genre/year is a known minor design deviation.
